model: five existing supervised P1+P2 reference checkpoints, each trained on 320 TRAIN labels, evaluated on its 80 held-out TRAIN labels
coverage: per fold, 3D normalized VAD 8th-neighbor radius; threshold 75th percentile of 320 fit leave-one-out radii
constants: per fold mean and median of 320 fit labels
evaluation: aggregate 400 strictly held-out predictions; region skill and errors only, no pooling with P3B probe model
